about: District and coordinates for master-list records, gathered with web search (one place per query). Each value cites the page the search answer named; the page itself was not fetched here, so every value is UNVERIFIED and must be checked before publishing. Applied with: npm run enrich:seed -- --from-file data/source/master-v1-websearch.json
